record.paper_title: Solutions to four open problems on quorum colorings of graphs
record.original_question: Characterize the graphs G with diameter exactly 2 for which the quorum coloring number ψ_q(G) equals 1.

evidence.quote: 4. Characterize the class of graphs G, with diam(G) = 2 for which ψq(G) = 1.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G = (V, E) be a finite, simple, undirected graph. For a vertex v ∈ V, let N[v] denote the closed neighborhood of v, that is, N[v] = {v} ∪ {u ∈ V : uv ∈ E}. A partition π = {V_1, V_2, …, V_k} of V into k nonempty color classes is called a quorum coloring of G if for every vertex v ∈ V, at least half of the vertices in N[v] belong to the same color class as v. The quorum coloring number ψ_q(G) is defined as the maximum number of color classes k over all quorum colorings of G.

The diameter diam(G) of a connected graph G is the maximum, over all pairs of vertices u, v ∈ V, of the length of a shortest path between u and v.

Problem: Give a structural characterization of all connected graphs G with diam(G) = 2 such that ψ_q(G) = 1 (i.e., the only quorum coloring of G is the trivial partition with a single color class).
artifact.status_search_result: Search results indicate that no general characterization of graphs with ψ_q(G) = 1 is known, and that obtaining such a characterization is unlikely unless P = NP ∩ co-NP. Subsequent works have constructed new infinite families of graphs with ψ_q(G) = 1 (including some of unbounded diameter), but the specific question restricted to diameter-2 graphs does not appear to have been resolved.

status_evidence.title: On some open problems concerning quorum colorings of graphs
status_evidence.snippet: There is no good characterization of the graphs G with ψ_q(G) = 1 nor for those with ψ_q(G) > 1 unless P = NP ∩ co-NP.
status_evidence.claim: A general characterization of graphs with ψ_q(G) = 1 is unlikely under standard complexity assumptions, suggesting the diameter-2 restriction remains open.

status_evidence.title: Solutions to four open problems on quorum colorings of graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Solutions to four open problems on quorum colorings of graphs.
status_evidence.claim: This work resolves several open quorum-coloring problems but lists the diameter-2 characterization as still open.
